subject: MS NOW crew gets stuck in Texas desert
posts: When a routine news shoot in the remote Texas desert leaves both reporters and their Border Patrol rescuers stranded, the optics turn into a political football. MS NOW crew gets stuck in Texas desert.

An MSNBC news crew reporting on border barriers and eminent domain found themselves stranded in the remote Big Bend desert, requiring an emergency rescue by Border Patrol agents as darkness fell.

While reporting on local landowner opposition to border barriers, the crew's vehicle became stuck, leading to an operation where three of the four rescue trucks also became trapped in the harsh terrain.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.4, -0.5) — Lesser Evil
